g.text: Figure 4a — UML Class diagram — project-owned application contracts
Concrete record type is the discriminant.
UML Class diagram: application-owned contracts are the stable pivot across hexagonal adapters.
Authentication state is a sealed project-owned OperatorContext; Spring Security types stop at
adapters. Source truth remains CustomerSnapshot/RiskEvidence. Detector evidence, retrieval
evidence and model/backend provenance share a sealed typed artifact family without sharing
authority. Persistence relations and provider/framework response types do not become members
